# End-to-end cases of cmd/fpgpsp: "<name> <arguments>" (words separated by
# blanks; "<file" redirects standard input). The golden outputs in golden/
# are produced by the C oracle (reference/build.sh fpgpsp-fixed) with
# reference/harness/fpgpsp/gen-cli.sh. Only deterministic cases: every
# surrogate case fixes -S and -Z; the estimation (-ge) is compared with C
# by difftest's TestFpgpsp with a derived tolerance, not here.
usage
help -!
help2 -t -!
# --- option errors ---
badopt -q test1.tab
optarg test1.tab -R
noargs -gi
args3 test1.tab out.txt extra
target -tx test1.tab -
target0 -t test1.tab -
variant -Ax test1.tab -
method -gx test1.tab -
method0 -g test1.tab -
size -m-1 test1.tab -
size2 -n-2 test1.tab -
surrcnt -c0 test1.tab -
surrcnt2 -c-5 -gr test1.tab -
nofile -gi missing.tab -
nosel -gi -R missing.txt test1.tab -
noitems -gi empty.tab -
noitems2 -gi blank.tab -
nofreq -gi -s-100 test1.tab -
nofreq2 -gr -s-100 -S1 -Z1 test1.tab -
notable -gs test1.tab -
notable1 -gs onerow.tab -
outopen -gi test1.tab nodir/out.txt
# --- surrogate methods (fixed -S and -Z) ---
ident -gi -s-2 test1.tab -
ident-c -gi -s-2 -c50 test1.tab -
ident-D -gi -s-2 -D test1.tab -
ident-tc -gi -tc -s-2 test1.tab -
ident-tm -gi -tm -s-2 basket.tab -
ident-tg -gi -tg -s-2 basket.tab -
ident-m0 -gi -m0 -s-2 test1.tab -
rand -gr -s-2 -c40 -S7 -Z1 test1.tab -
rand-Z2 -gr -s-2 -c19 -S7 -Z2 test1.tab -
rand-Z4 -gr -s-2 -c19 -S7 -Z4 test1.tab -
rand-basket -gr -s-3 -c25 -S3 -Z1 basket.tab -
rand-D -gr -s-3 -c25 -S3 -Z3 -D basket.tab -
rand-i -gr -i -s-3 -c10 -S5 -Z1 basket.tab -
rand-As -gr -As -s-3 -c10 -S5 -Z2 basket.tab -
rand-tc -gr -tc -s-3 -c10 -S2 -Z1 basket.tab -
rand-tg -gr -tg -s-3 -c10 -S2 -Z1 dense.tab -
rand-m2 -gr -m2 -n3 -s-3 -c10 -S2 -Z1 basket.tab -
rand-pct -gr -s20 -c10 -S2 -Z1 dense.tab -
rand-big-seed -gr -s-3 -c6 -S4294967295 -Z2 basket.tab -
rand-neg-seed -gr -s-3 -c6 -S-3 -Z2 basket.tab -
swap -gp -s-2 -c40 -S7 -Z1 test1.tab -
swap-basket -gp -s-3 -c30 -S11 -Z1 basket.tab -
swap-Z3 -gp -s-3 -c30 -S11 -Z3 basket.tab -
swap-tm -gp -tm -Ad -s-3 -c12 -S1 -Z1 dense.tab -
swap-tg -gp -tg -s-4 -c12 -S1 -Z2 dense.tab -
swap-x -gp -x -s-3 -c12 -S1 -Z1 basket.tab -
swap-l0 -gp -As -l0 -s-3 -c12 -S1 -Z1 basket.tab -
swap-D -gp -s-3 -c12 -S1 -Z1 -D dense.tab -
swap-D-m2 -gp -s-3 -m2 -n2 -c12 -S1 -Z1 -D dense.tab -
shuffle -gs -s-2 -c30 -S1 -Z1 table.tab -
shuffle-Z2 -gs -s-2 -c30 -S1 -Z2 table.tab -
shuffle-m4 -gs -m4 -s-2 -c5 -S1 -Z1 table.tab -
shuffle-D -gs -s-2 -c30 -S9 -Z1 -D table.tab -
# --- input and output ---
onearg -gi -s-2 test1.tab
outfile -gp -s-2 -c5 -S1 -Z1 test1.tab out.txt
stdin -gp -s-2 -c5 -S1 -Z1 - - <test1.tab
sel -gp -s-2 -c5 -S1 -Z1 -R sel.txt test1.tab -
csv -gp -s-2 -c5 -S1 -Z1 -f, test2.tab -
